custodianAssessment: The City of Bridgeport is the evidenced local GIS custodian/context; the public parcel geometry is served through the Greater Bridgeport Regional Council / MetroCOG ArcGIS service. General state or national agencies were not treated as the local custodian.
queryAndRequestOutcome: See city record request outcomes. The official City GIS discovery path led to an anonymous ArcGIS polygon layer. Exact supplied point returned zero features; a bounded 0.02-degree envelope returned three polygons and exceededTransferLimit=true.

nativeSchema.geometry: esriGeometryPolygon; native service spatial reference WKID 102656/latest 2234 (NAD83 Connecticut State Plane feet); query output requested in EPSG:4326 GeoJSON
nativeSchema.nativeIdentity: Parcel_ID string, corroborated by GIS_ID; OBJECTID_12 is the service OID
nativeSchema.retainedPropertiesPolicy: No sample GeoJSON retained; if later retained, each feature must contain exactly {"id": Parcel_ID} and no raw source attributes.
nativeSchema.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key used; Parcel_ID is the preferred stable native parcel identity and GIS_ID was corroboration only.

scopeLimits: Bounded anonymous requests only; no citywide enumeration or completeness claim.
The exact-point miss cannot be used as evidence of citywide parcel absence.
The envelope is centered on the supplied WUP point and is not a municipal-boundary query.
The service metadata exposes unsafe owner, address, tax, assessment, sale, and contact-related fields; they were not retained or integrated.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
No parcel polygon was retained because the bounded service response was not necessary to establish source qualification and included unsafe fields in the exploratory payload.
uncertainty: The public City/MetroCOG parcel service is usable anonymously, but this packet does not qualify an adapter, guarantee current completeness, or authorize runtime admission. The exact WUP point lies outside or does not intersect a returned parcel at the tested coordinate; that result is intentionally treated only as a local miss.
